purpose: Teach: 防護/寄生虫/万引き/罵倒/国策/保釈/喚問/殺傷

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、災害時の防護服の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote your paper on the history of protective suits during disasters, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Warm, open-ended check-in. Steady, conversational pace. Light curiosity without pressure. The tone of a teacher who's read and engaged with the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、寄生虫感染症の医学史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the medical history of parasitic infections.
lines.style: Quiet, precise correction. No apology in it, just clarity. Direct eye contact level. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 都市部の万引き犯罪統計を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered urban shoplifting crime statistics in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle reframing, as if turning a page. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Genuinely curious where this is going. Not testing, just following the thread.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ネット罵倒の社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — I wrote about the sociology of online harassment.
lines.style: Patient but firm. Stands by the correction without irritation. Small breath before answering, centered and calm.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国策事業の歴史的影響を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The historical impact of national policy initiatives — that was your topic, wasn't it?
lines.style: Engaged, leaning slightly forward. Genuine interest in the subject matter. Warm but measured. Testing whether Sakura will correct again.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦後の保釈制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I examined the postwar bail system.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching. Matter-of-fact correction delivered without frustration. Slight lift at the end, moving past it. Grounded and self-assured.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国会喚問の事例史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Diet summons and their case history — that's what you investigated, correct?
lines.style: Calm, observant. Paced slowly, almost like Asuka is checking something against her notes. Reflective, not accusing. Waiting for the answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の殺傷統計を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — my paper was on casualty statistics during wartime.
lines.style: Direct, final. No wavering. Quiet but certain. Slight closure in the delivery, as if Sakura has stated something important and is done correcting now.
